briefdescription.para: Sets the device bRefClkFreq attribute.

detaileddescription.para: This API sets the reference clock frequency attribute (bRefClkFreq) on the UFS device based on the configured reference pad clock frequency.
The function maps the reference pad clock frequency from the instance configuration to the appropriate UFS attribute value and writes it to the device using a query command.

simplesect.para:
The supported reference clock frequencies are:
19.2 MHz (XUFSPSXC_CLK_SEL_19P2)
26 MHz (XUFSPSXC_CLK_SEL_26)
38.4 MHz (XUFSPSXC_CLK_SEL_38P4)
52 MHz (XUFSPSXC_CLK_SEL_52)
